title: Power Stability of Finitely Generated Dynamical Frames for Positive Operators
summary: Let \( Λ=\{λ_j\}_{j\in\mathbb N}\subset[0,1) \) be a finite union of Carleson sequences, and let \( Λ^p=\{λ_j^p\}_{j\in\mathbb N} \) for \(p>0\). We prove that \(Λ\) and \(Λ^p\) admit compatible Hartmann-type cluster decompositions and that, under the natural coordinate identification, \( H^2(Λ)=H^2(Λ^p). \) After taking account of the change in the normalization weights, this trace-space identity gives \( \operatorname{Ran}(T_Λ) = \operatorname{Ran}(T_{Λ^p}) \) for the associated weighted evaluation operators.
